# Stable classes

<!-- Generated by `pnpm docs:selectors` from each component's stable names. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every class below is a public override target: one class, so a consumer rule on it wins over the
library's rule (add the same state, such as `:hover` or `[data-state=active]`, to restyle a state).
A root is always present and a part whenever its element renders; a modifier is present when the
prop has that value, including its default. Components not listed have not moved to this convention yet.

## Button

| Stable class | Kind | Present when |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `.openui-button` | Root | Always |
| `.openui-button-icon` | Part (`icon`) | On that part, whenever it renders |
| `.openui-button--variant-primary` | Modifier | `variant="primary"` |
| `.openui-button--variant-secondary` | Modifier | `variant="secondary"` |
| `.openui-button--variant-tertiary` | Modifier | `variant="tertiary"` |
| `.openui-button--size-extra-small` | Modifier | `size="extra-small"` |
| `.openui-button--size-small` | Modifier | `size="small"` |
| `.openui-button--size-medium` | Modifier | `size="medium"` |
| `.openui-button--size-large` | Modifier | `size="large"` |
| `.openui-button--tone-default` | Modifier | `tone="default"` |
| `.openui-button--tone-destructive` | Modifier | `tone="destructive"` |
